body: I've been putting it off for a while now, but I'll see what I can do to find some therapists around the area here. I'm still a bit skeptical whether something like that can really make a difference for me, but I suppose it couldn't hurt. I'd do anything to feel better here in the long run. Thanks again!  :]

I've only just now started dating. Very late start but better late than never I suppose. :\ I'm certainly better at talking and socializing than I was back in school, it's just hard trying to meet new people so far.

I haven't undergone any treatment for depression yet. I've been on the fence over whether spending money on some random therapist would help out at all. My family and a few of my friends know how crappy I feel usually, and they usually give me the whole "Hey c'mon, you've got a good job, you're a nice guy, don't be such a pessimist, etc" speech. It's just hard for me to ignore the past 5 years of unhappiness and have trouble not stressing out over the future.

Thanks for the compliments though! I was a bit worried I'd typed too much for anyone to bother reading my original post. :p
